<span class="tag">Consortium</span>

### IS4NCDs: core modules

I lead Work Package 5 (Core Modules) of the IS4NCDs consortium, which develops short courses and a curriculum roadmap for implementation science in non-communicable diseases, working with partner institutions in Europe and Africa.
:::

::: {.card}
<span class="tag">Centre</span>

### Centre for Computational Health Sciences

I am establishing the Centre for Computational Health Sciences at Copperbelt University, to bring bioinformatics, structural biology and data science into health research and teaching at the School.
:::

::: {.card}
<span class="tag">Programme</span>

### MSc and DSc in Pharmacogenomics and Personalised Medicine

I lead the development of these proposed postgraduate programmes, which are being prepared for accreditation by the Higher Education Authority.
:::

::: {.card}
<span class="tag">Network</span>

### African Bioethics Network

I serve as the Country Representative for Zambia, contributing to ethics governance materials and capacity building.
:::

### HIGH IRI Fellowship

I am an incoming HIGH IRI Fellow at Washington University in St. Louis, in residence in Cape Town.
